name: volta-newsletter
description: A monthly newsletter reviewed inside Claude: gathers, dedupes and drafts from your sources; you pick items and press send.
long_description: No AI writes newsletter text. Items are taken from real sources (news feeds, calendars, LinkedIn, Slack, and events you add yourself) and put into fixed templates, and a verifier rejects any name, date or link that isn't in a source or in your own words. Runs as Volta's newsletter by default; say "set up the newsletter" in chat to name your own organisation instead — that takes effect at once and needs no reinstall. Starts in dry run: nothing reaches Mailchimp until you turn on live mode below.

mailchimp_api_key.title: Mailchimp API key
mailchimp_api_key.description: From Mailchimp → Account → Extras → API keys. Its suffix (-us21) names the data centre. Leave empty to run without Mailchimp — approve then saves the newsletter as a file instead.

mailchimp_list_id.title: Mailchimp audience (list) ID
mailchimp_list_id.description: The audience the newsletter goes to.

mailchimp_reply_to.title: Reply-to address
mailchimp_reply_to.description: The verified email address on the Mailchimp account.

mailchimp_from_name.title: Sender name
mailchimp_from_name.description: Optional. The organisation's name is used when this is left empty.

slack_bot_token.title: Slack bot token
slack_bot_token.description: Only needed if a Slack channel is one of your sources. A bot token (xoxb-) with channels:history, channels:read and users:read.

live_mode.title: Live mode
live_mode.description: On: approve creates a real Mailchimp campaign and send reaches your real audience. Off (the default): nothing leaves this computer.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where your sources, ticks, edits and settings are kept. Kept outside this extension, so an update never touches it. Defaults to a folder in your user profile.
